before.notes: Walkable open north fen off the reedbelt; room to wander out to the camera-clamped world edge. A natural reed-gap seam in the north border now opens onto the Great Fen (GREAT_FEN_C7RN2_MAP via EASTERN_FENS_ENVELOPE_C7RN1_MAP). The sole random encounter here is the Fen Zolom — essentially unwinnable, escape blocked — guarding the gate into the Great Fen; no items, NPCs, interactions, or quest triggers, and no new save bindings beyond the encounter itself.

after.notes: North Fen approach. An arrival dialogue warns of Fen Zolom territory before movement or encounter rolls; ordinary running remains blocked, while Serpentsmoke permits escape.
